extracted text: The material used in this study was 7075 aluminum alloy. The commercial alloy obtained as cylindrical blocks was forged with intermittent soaking (at 753 K (480 °C)) followed by rolling to plates. For T6 temper, the specimens were first solution annealed at 753 K (480 °C) for 1 hour and then heated at 120 °C for 24 hours. For T73 temper condition, the specimens were solution annealed followed by two-step isothermal annealing at 380 K (107 °C) for 6 hours followed by annealing at 436 K (163 °C) for 24 hours.
